blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — One of the first female graduates of the Philippine Military Academy (PMA) and its first female summa cum laude has been promoted to Army Brigadier General. Army Brig. Gen. Leah Lorenzo Santiago was accorded arrival honors at the military school’s Sundial on Tuesday after receiving her one rank bump-up along with 12 other promoted generals at Camp Aguinaldo on Monday, said Navy Lt. Commander Jesse Nestor Saludo, head of the PMA information office, in a statement on Thursday. Santiago was appointed as PMA Commandant of Cadets and credited as the first female officer to occupy that post, as well […]...
